comparison.objective: Hand-guide a Franka arm to a service pose and teach it.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain a three-position enabling switch in its middle band while dragging an articulated arm and pressing Teach.
comparison.success_condition: Reach within 15 mm and 5 degrees, release controls, teach pose, clear hands, and hold 1 s; collisions and joint-limit contact fail.
comparison.reason: Constrained robot hand-guiding and safety-button control do not test pouring, bridging, or screen-mediated material separation. No material rubric detail is missing.
